readiness_evidence: Not ready to offer: this release carries the 0.12.0 changes, whose general hosted replay and decline run are still pending.

Offline: fault reports now use a five-second send budget, retire a report after two failed send attempts while recording its fingerprint for the deduplication window so later reports are not blocked, and drop queued items older than 24 hours (test_fault_reports.py). Running help on a flow subcommand stays read-only and does not trigger the resume check or record a false contract violation (test_resume_after_restart.py).

Existing businesses and the registry stay compatible: no USP, UCP, or platform profile version changed and no request shape changed. Saved session files are unchanged: no field was added and the format version stays as it is.
user_summary: Background fault reports no longer resend when the support service responds slowly, and help checks do not interrupt a saved booking.
